name: Vorta
description: In the recovered Vorta updater, frozen macOS builds load Sparkle, select a stable or pre-release HTTPS appcast, optionally enable background checks, and disable automatic downloads. The reviewed source does not establish a SUPublicEDKey, Apple Developer ID fallback, or updater implementation for non-macOS builds.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Sparkle framework enforcement, released bundle signing identity, SUPublicEDKey or fallback behavior, and platform packaging were not independently audited.
